_comment: Home screen line, by time of day. Second person, present tense, short. No exclamation marks, no praise.
dawn: The day has not decided what it is yet.
You are awake before your name is.
Nothing has been asked of you. Yet.
day: The noise can wait at the door.
You were somewhere else. Come back.
dusk: The light is leaving. Let it.
What you carried today, set it down here.
The edges soften. So can you.
night: The dark is not empty. You are in it.
It is late. That is why you came.
